items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Well, I tell you that Bricktop hired us all, right, and Peter was her husband, he was a member of the orchestra, naturally. And there was Freddie Johnson, Arthur Briggs, Billy Taylor, and I can't remember who was on bass now -- Herb Fleming --

ctx.x:
Well, Herb knew
that I was in Paris, and he had Luke Smith,
one of the famous Smith --
